Subject: Submission of renewable energy research paper
Dear Professor Lopez,
I am sending you my paper on “Renewable Energy Policies in Urban
Areas” by email because the online submission portal is down. I know
that you prefer not to receive student work this way, but I hope you
will understand, given the circumstances.
Would you like me to resubmit the paper once the portal comes back
up? (Also, have any other students been affected by the outage, or is
it just me?)
The document includes all required charts, citations, and the
executive summary. I also incorporated feedback from our last
meeting regarding comparative analysis of solar- and wind-energy
adoption.
Please confirm receipt of this email so I know it meets today’s 5:30
P.M. deadline. If there are any formatting issues, I can resend
immediately. Thank you for your understanding and support during
this technical glitch.
Best regards,
Daniel Brooks
